OVERVIEW.NOTE_INVENTORY: Inventory balances are the current snapshot. The period filter does not turn them into historical balances.
OVERVIEW.NOTE_CONFIRMED_VALUE: Confirmed Order Value is the historical subtotal of confirmed, shipped, and delivered orders. It is not cash received, accounting revenue, profit, or margin.

OVERVIEW.NOTE_STATUS: Each status uses its own milestone date. These counts are not monetary values and do not have to add up to orders created in the period.
